subject: english
q: Which word is a verb in the sentence 'The kids played soccer'?
explain: Played is the action in the sentence, so it is the verb.

subject: english
q: Which word is a noun in the sentence 'A bright moon shone'?
explain: Moon names a thing, so it is a noun. Bright is an adjective, and shone is a verb.
